build_PiecewiseLinearFn_from_string: build a PiecewiseLinearFn from a string config like '0:1,1000:0' for scheduling lambda coefficients
create_PiecewiseLinearFn_one: create a constant PiecewiseLinearFn that always returns 1.0 using the one class method
build_OnlineBackTranslationTask: build an OnlineBackTranslationTask to train a multilingual model with backtranslation and denoising autoencoder objectives
run_backtranslate_sample: run backtranslation on a sample by generating source tokens in another language using the sequence generator
extend_embedding: extend a model embedding layer to a larger vocab size by copying an existing token embedding
